deliver_failed: [{label}] Couldn't deliver the answer ({error}) — the engine won't run again. You can get it again with /last
ask.work_mode: (work mode: you'll be asked before file edits or commands)
approval.request:
[{label}] Approval request {n}: {what} — {summary}{cwd}
Allow: /{allow} {n}   Deny: /{deny} {n}   (within 15 min, this time only)
approval.handoff:
[{label}] Human task {n}: {what} — {summary}{cwd}
The AI was told not to do it. If you did it yourself, /{done} {n}; if you won't, /{drop} {n} (owner only)
ask.usage_limit: [{label}] {err} — account in use: {account}. Send the same question again after the limit resets, or switch to another registered account (Settings → Account on the Ieon screen).
ask.unknown: [{label}] Result unknown{joined} — it won't be resent automatically. Check the original session, then /review done or /review not
ask.approval_required: [{label}] Stopped because a permission check is needed in the original session — after handling it, /review done or /review not
ask.cancelled: [{label}] Stopped — only this question was stopped (not resent)
ask.timeout: [{label}] No answer yet — get it with /last when it's done (it won't run again)
whoami.name: Bot name: {name}
default_session: Connected this chat to the default session "{label}" ({role} role). To change it, use /sessions then /use <number>.
help.call: To call in a group: "{name}, …" or @mention
help.body:
Commands
/sessions List sessions
/use <number> Connect this chat to that session
/status Status of the connected session
/review done|not Resolve a question that needs review
/new codex|claude|antigravity <name> [read_only|workspace] Create a new session and connect this chat to it
/sleep <name> Put to sleep
/archived Archived list
/restore <name> Restore from archive
/close <name> Delete (with a confirmation step)
/limits Session count and limits
/{allow} <number> · /{deny} <number> Answer a work mode approval request (owner only)
/{done} <number> · /{drop} <number> Record a task handed to a human (owner only)
/last Get the last answer again (doesn't run again)
/stop Stop only the last question in this chat (asker or owner)
/whoami My ID
Any other message is sent as a question to the connected session.
new.created: Created a new {engine} session "{name}" (permission {profile}) and connected this chat to it. It starts when you send the first question.
ns.slept: "{name}" is asleep (asking a question wakes it up)
close.confirm: This deletes "{name}". Its Ieon records will be erased and this can't be undone (the original Codex/Claude records and work folder may remain depending on settings). To continue: /close {name} {confirm}
decide.owner_only: Only this bot's owner can approve
decide.not_found: Approval request {n} isn't in this chat
decide.status.handoff: handed to a human — /{done} n or /{drop} n
decide.status.pending: still awaiting approval — /{allow} n or /{deny} n
stop.none: Nothing to stop (no question received in this chat this time)
stop.not_allowed: Only the person who sent that question or the owner can stop it
stop.cancelled: [{label}] Stopped — it hadn't started yet, so it was canceled right away
stop.stopping: [{label}] Stopping — you'll be told "Stopped" once the engine is confirmed stopped
stop.unsupported: [{label}] This session (a Claude window opened by a person) can't be stopped from here while running — stop it in the original window
last.none: No answer to resend (no question received in this chat this time)
last.pending: [{label}] The last question isn't finished yet or has no answer ({word})
use.not_found: No session with that number — check with /sessions
no_session: No session is connected to this chat — /sessions then /use <number>
status.same_session: Question needing review: the session it was sent to is the same as the current one — check in the original app, then /review done or /review not
status.other_session: Question needing review: ⚠ the session it was sent to differs from the one connected now — open that session to check
status.deliver_failed: Last answer: delivery failed — get it again with /last
review.not: [{label}] Marked as not run — ask again if needed
notice.archive: [{name}] Will be archived on {date} — send a question to keep using it (you can restore it with /restore even after it's archived)
sched.head: [{label}] Scheduled question ({when})
sched.unknown: {head}: result unknown — it won't be resent automatically, and this schedule will pause at the next run (check the original session, then turn it back on in Settings → Work → Scheduled tasks on the Ieon screen)
sched.approval_required: {head}: stopped because a permission check is needed in the original session
kakao.slow: The answer is taking a while. When it's done, send /last to get it.
kakao.busy: Still working on the answer. Please send /last again in a moment.
kakao.cut: …(shortened because it's long — see the full text on the web screen)
line.received: Got it. Working on the answer — I'll send it when it's done.
line.only_direct: For now this only works in 1:1 chats. Please send it in a 1:1 chat with the bot.
claim.linked: Connected to your Ieon account. This chat now shows only your conversations. Choose one with /sessions.
claim.already: You're already allowed, so nothing extra was registered. The screen will show it as done.
claim.owner: You're registered as the owner. Ask a question and it will continue from there. You can choose a conversation with /sessions.
claim.locked: Locked after too many wrong numbers. Get a new number on the Ieon screen.
claim.wrong: The number doesn't match. Check the number on the Ieon screen again.
relay.pc_down: The Ieon PC isn't connected. Turn on the PC and send again.
relay.full: Too many requests are waiting right now. Please send again in a moment.
relay.no_callback: Can't send the answer because the AI chatbot callback isn't turned on for this block. Check your Open Builder settings.
